items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Billy Strayhorn; Interviewee responds with 'Yeah, yeah, sure' regarding musicians from Ohio/Cleveland, showing no personal connection or direct interaction with Strayhorn.

ctx.x: Like I said, we keep going farther and farther back all the time.

Anyway, I must say, this is one of the three great Shakespeare jazz albums, I supposed. You have mention Duke Ellington and Billy Strayhorn, I guess. He gets credit on it, too. The album, 'Such Sweet Thunder,' which is, from when? The mid-50's I think they did that?
